description.value: The Vogue Theatre is a 1,161-capacity Art Deco concert hall built in 1941 on Vancouver's historic Granville Street entertainment strip, one of the last surviving venues from the city's famed Theatre Row. Operated by the MRG Group, it hosts upwards of 200 live music, cinema, and community events annually and has repeatedly won the Canadian Music Week Best Performing Arts Centre Award. A touring cyclist looking for an evening of live entertainment in downtown Vancouver would find this a distinctive and historically significant destination.
